node.title: Input Boxes Rendering?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Fellow monks, could you try going to [id://1040] and seeing if the following renders as actual input boxes?

<input $1> <input $2>

Because that is what is happening for me when I view [id://1193338|this node] via [id://479|SoPW], as well as this node via [id://1040|PMD]. (Posted at the request of [tye ].)

Update: Also happening for me when viewing SoPW as anonymous. Edited the title to remove "in SoPW" since it's happening in PMD too.

Update 2: Relevant HTML source of [id://1040|PMD]:

    Fellow monks, could you try going to Perl Monks Discussion and seeing if the following renders as actual input boxes?

    Because that is what is happening ...
